key_idea: This is exactly largest rectangle in a histogram: the best bin has capacity equal to the minimum of a maximal interval.
sketch: For every week compute with a monotonic stack the maximal interval [L,R] on which it is the minimum (strict on both sides so equal bars share the same full interval), candidate value a[i]*(R-L+1), keep the maximum with ties broken by smallest start, then smallest end. O(n), 64-bit for the product. Pitfalls: output is 1-indexed start, end, amount; input numbers span several lines. The statement does not say how to break ties between intervals with the same start and same total (e.g. 4 4 2 2) or what to print when all values are 0; this solution prints the shortest such interval, which is a guess.
